entries.title: PostReady: PR #839 — Add public /contact page
entries.description: A public-facing /contact page added to PostReady, providing a direct outreach path for prospects and clients.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #840 — Fix atmosphere fragments fighting the intensity lever
entries.description: Atmosphere fragment intensity lever conflict resolved in Bring to Life feature — fragments now correctly respond to the intensity control without competing with each other.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #841 — Fix dialogs scrollable on mobile (tall dialogs unusable)
entries.description: Tall dialogs are now scrollable on mobile, fixing an accessibility/usability regression where modal content was cut off on small screens.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #842 — Show the prompt a pack was made from
entries.description: Post packs now display the original prompt they were generated from, giving users a clear record of what creative direction produced each pack.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #843 — Asset provenance capture + honest AI ownership terms
entries.description: Compliance sprint: PostReady now records the provenance of generated assets and updates Terms to clearly state AI-generated content ownership — transparency and legal clarity for users.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #844 — Likeness consent on upload + public content-report route
entries.description: Compliance sprint: users now consent to likeness rights at upload time, and a public /report endpoint lets anyone flag content violations — building trust and legal defensibility for PostReady.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #845 — Alert on new content reports (compliance sprint complete)
entries.description: PostReady now emails support@zippityone.com when a /report submission arrives, completing the compliance sprint. Ensures the 48-hour NCII response promise is actionable, not just stated.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #846 — Match prompt panel to its dark neighbours (UI polish)
entries.description: The prompt panel now matches the dark UI surrounding it, fixing a visual inconsistency in the Create area.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #847 — Make Fireflies slow, dense and magical (Bring to Life)
entries.description: Fireflies atmosphere overlay tuned for slower, denser, more magical motion — quality refinement for the Bring to Life effects suite.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #848 — Fireflies are insects, not orbs (Bring to Life)
entries.description: Visual fidelity fix for the Fireflies Bring to Life effect — fireflies now rendered as elongated, insect-like shapes rather than round orbs.
